text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert -> trigger: host-gpu-usw2-07 (us-west-2) reported KERNEL_PANIC, severity: P1, runbook: https://runbooks/internal/gpu-host-kernel-panic :rotating_light:

maria (on-call): acked pagerduty, I'm on it. paging infra on-call.

ajay (infra): on my way, ping me if you need me to take over. do we know impact? any customer-facing 5xxs yet?

maria (on-call): grafana shows a spike in 503s for /v1/generate in us-west-2 between 14:23-14:30. approx 8% error rate for the region, some Dedicated customers seeing degraded throughput. link: https://grafana/internal/d/hosts/usw2

eli (sre-2nd): tagging into thread. can you paste the initial alert output?

incident-bot: Alert details:
- node: host-gpu-usw2-07 (10.12.7.85)
- time: 2026-03-14T14:23:41Z
- symptoms: kernel panic, node offline, kubelet NotReady
- pagerduty runbook: https://runbooks/internal/gpu-host-kernel-panic

maria (on-call): ran quick checks, cannot ssh to node (connection timed out). k8s shows node NotReady and several pods in CrashLoopBackOff that were pinned to local GPU.

maria (on-call): pasted outputs: 
```
$ kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep host-gpu-usw2-07
host-gpu-usw2-07   NotReady   62d   <none>   10.12.7.85   <none>
```

maria (on-call): from node-exporter we got a heartbeat stop at 14:23:39. dmesg snippet from last saved console (via BMC console log):
```
[  725.123456] BUG: unable to handle kernel NULL pointer dereference at 0000000000000008
[  725.123459] CPU: 3 PID: 9876 Comm: kworker/3:2 Not tainted
[  725.123461] Call Trace:
[  725.123462]  ? gpu_driver_fault+0x1a3/0x3f0
[  725.123463] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception
```

ajay (infra): looks like a GPU driver oops causing panic. priority: cordon the node from scheduler and prevent new pods landing. maria can you cordon?

maria (on-call): cordoned and annotated for maintenance: `kubectl cordon host-gpu-usw2-07 && kubectl annotate node host-gpu-usw2-07 maintenance=true` :white_check_mark:

maria (on-call): starting drain for evictable pods (skip local-critical):
```
$ kubectl drain host-gpu-usw2-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
```

ops-runbook-bot: Reminder: If node unresponsive to SSH check, escalate to oncall infra to request BMC/IPMI console snapshot and attempt remote-reboot.

eli (sre-2nd): requesting BMC console now, @sam can you pull last serial log and attempt remote reboot?

sam (platform): grabbing serial logs... initiating soft reboot via IPMI (remote-reboot) now. will update with outcome.

infra-bot: PD escalated to SRE lead (level 2) after 5 minutes without recovery.

maria (on-call): note: we've Rerouted traffic via smart-router policy to aws-usw2-fallback pool to mitigate 503s. latency unchanged but error rate dropping.

ajay (infra): good. collecting kubelet logs from controller-manager pods for eviction traces. Also opening a ticket with cloud provider about host hardware/driver.

sam (platform): IPMI reboot completed at 14:34:10Z. serial shows POST, kernel started booting then hung on nvidia driver init at 14:36:02Z. posting serial tail: 
```
[  32.564321] nvidia: loading module v5.8.0
[  32.564322] nvidia: pci: bridge config
[  33.999999] nvidia 0000:3b:00.0: GPU fault detected
[  34.000123] Kernel panic - not syncing: gpu fault induced panic
```

eli (sre-2nd): this is repeating. recommend we reimage node or remove from pool and reprovision. if reimage takes too long, migrate critical jobs to spare nodes in other racks.

maria (on-call): coordinate with provisioning. ajay, can you kick off reprovision for host-gpu-usw2-07? tag it as emergency reprovision.

ajay (infra): creating reprovision job with cloud APIs now. commit id: rp-20260314-001. will force reattach after new image. ETA ~20-30m.

maria (on-call): customer impact note for postmortem: some Dedicated customers in us-west-2 saw degraded throughput and transient 503s during 14:23-14:40. no data exfiltration, no config change. Need to notify CS for customers on contracts.

eli (sre-2nd): agreed. @maria can you file the incident ticket and mark P1, include timeline and mitigation steps. I'll take ownership for remediation and postmortem.

maria (on-call): creating incident in internal tracker: https://incidents/internal/INC-2026-0314-07. adding timeline and linking graphs.

ops-runbook-bot: Postmortem template recommended fields: timeline, root cause, mitigation, long-term fix.

sam (platform): reprovision completed at 14:58:12Z, node returned healthy and Ready at 15:01:02Z after new image with kernel 5.15 and nvidia-driver 525. successful health checks and pods scheduled.

maria (on-call): uncordoned the node and watched pod reschedules. error rate back to baseline at 15:10. marking incident resolved for on-call rotation, handing to eli for postmortem.

eli (sre-2nd): will run kernel/driver compatibility tests against the image used and coordinate with infra/benchmarks to prevent drift. action items: (1) reprovision pipeline to block kernel-driver combos known to panic, (2) schedule maintenance window to replace host hardware if hardware fault confirmed, (3) customer comms drafted by CS.

ajay (infra): opened provider ticket referencing host serial logs and kernel oops. case id: CP-94218. provider acknowledged hardware probe.

maria (on-call): final: incident time window 2026-03-14T14:23:41Z -> 2026-03-14T15:10:00Z. follow-up owners: eli (postmortem), ajay (infra reprovision pipeline), sam (platform image validation). thanks all :pray: 

incident-bot: Incident resolved in PagerDuty.
